summary: U.S. Congressman, NY legislator, president of the Seventh Ward Bank; John's 5th cousin 6x removed.
bio:
Path: Elizabeth → Joseph → Richard → John → Effingham (b. 1760, a founder of the Tontine Coffee House) → John W. Same family: Watson E. Lawrence, founder of Lawrenceville, Ulster Co., maker of Rosendale hydraulic cement (5C6R).

Son of Effingham Lawrence (b. 6 Jun 1760, a founder of the Tontine Coffee House, d. 13 Dec 1800), son of John, son of Richard, son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith ([R4-S1]): 5th cousin 6 times removed. Married Mary K., daughter of Mayor Walter Bowne.
sources: [R4-S1] Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 46-47 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
[R4-S2] Wikipedia, 'John W. Lawrence' (intro via MediaWiki API) (secondary) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_W._Lawrence
